story.ch04.title: The Ash Ledger
story.ch04.summary: The release anchor holds the terms of an emergency that never ended.
story.ch04.s01.title: Warm Stone, Cold Water
story.ch04.s01.objective: Inspect the release-channel marks and clear a path to the archive.
story.ch04.s01.apprentice: The upper scale is warm. The channel below it is cold enough to frost. These are supposed to be the same flow.
story.ch04.s01.scale: Release scale: summer high-water line, then three winter notches cut progressively lower. The newest notch is barely above the channel floor.
story.ch04.s01.note: Ashen maintenance note, three winters before the Dry Bell: “Governor requests sanctuary reserve. Lower discharge reduced. Record the reduction as temporary. No review date supplied.”
story.ch04.s01.reader: The instructions sent me uphill to mend a broken anchor. Someone downstream has been living with a working one.
story.ch04.s01.lan: At the old release, look at the marks under the soot. A clean dial can lie. Stone takes longer.
story.ch04.s01.response_water: I will compare these notches with the intake records. If the numbers disagree, I will keep both.
story.ch04.s01.response_heat: First I need the heat-release schedule. We should not open a gate on guesswork.
story.ch04.s01.journal: Ashen Peak is retaining heat while downstream winter flow falls. A sanctuary-stability order explains the reduction, but provides no end date. The full regulator archive should identify who authorized it.
story.ch04.s01.retry: The cleared archive approach remains mapped. Retry from the entrance shrine; your banked realm and story evidence are preserved.
story.ch04.s02.title: Thirty Days
story.ch04.s02.objective: Restore the archive reader and read the original service agreement.
story.ch04.s02.reader: Original compact recovered. Flood Year 400, Rain Month, Day 3. Temporary governor service.
story.ch04.s02.compact: I, Shen Heng, accept the living-governor station for thirty days, ending Rain Month, Day 33 by the emergency count. My consent covers this term only. Any continuation requires a fresh request, my reply, and a named replacement plan.
story.ch04.s02.compact2: The closed cycle shall protect the floodplain during evacuation and repair. Afterward, the release channel must be restored. Downstream shortage and governor strain are emergency costs, not acceptable permanent allocations.
story.ch04.s02.witness: I checked the cooling figures. Thirty days allows us to rebuild the release steps. I have signed beside the term, not above it. If we cannot hand over, I will record that failure under my own name.
story.ch04.s02.echo: Put the families on the ridge before you close it. Tell the spillway crew I can hold this a month. A month, Yun. Give them a date they can plan around.
story.ch04.s02.apprentice: He did not volunteer for thirteen years. He gave them time to build a replacement.
story.ch04.s02.note: This fragment is a recording. It cannot hear your questions. Open the renewal ledger to find what happened when the term expired.
story.ch04.s02.response: Keep the original term visible beside every renewal. We are not repairing this without it.
story.ch04.s02.journal: Shen Heng agreed to thirty days. A continuation required his fresh reply and a replacement plan. Yun witnessed that limit. The recording establishes the original promise; it says nothing about Shen’s present wishes.
story.ch04.s02.skip: Read the compact summary and confirm the recorded thirty-day limit to continue. The full agreement remains in your journal.
story.ch04.s03.title: The Empty Name
story.ch04.s03.objective: Compare the renewals, guardian replies, and handover entries.
story.ch04.s03.renewal1: Request: retain the closed cycle until the release steps are funded. Guardian reply: not recorded. Replacement: not assigned. Downstream review: postponed until the emergency ends.
story.ch04.s03.renewal2: River Compact office: renew for one winter. Reason: reserves protect the sanctuary and its supply road. Guardian reply: not recorded. Handover name: not recorded.
story.ch04.s03.renewal3: The guardian remains responsive; therefore prior consent is presumed. Replacement study deferred to the next office. A lower-valley appeal is filed separately from maintenance costs.
story.ch04.s03.renewal4: Adaptive allocation approved to prevent sanctuary instability. Reduced winter discharge is classified as temporary. Guardian reply: not recorded. Renewal end date: not recorded.
story.ch04.s03.handover: Thirteen annual renewals. Thirteen unfilled replacement fields. Repair budgets identify new tiles, gates, and lamps; none assigns a person to take over Shen Heng’s service.
story.ch04.s03.yun: I accepted “still responsive” as proof that he could continue. That was a measure of function, not an answer to our request. I should have required an answer.
story.ch04.s03.apprentice: Every office inherited an emergency. Every office handed it onward. He was the only one who never changed shifts.
story.ch04.s03.response_signers: Preserve the signatures with the missing replies. No one’s responsibility disappears because an office changed hands.
story.ch04.s03.response_people: Attach the lower-valley reductions to these renewals. People were paying a cost the maintenance ledger hid.
story.ch04.s03.ask_signers: Keep the signatories in the record.
story.ch04.s03.ask_cost: Join the downstream records to the ledger.
story.ch04.s03.journal: The River Compact renewed the arrangement without recorded fresh consent or a replacement. Lan’s recent bypass worsened pressure, but this pattern began years before it. The archive identifies responsibility without making every resident or worker an enemy.
story.ch04.s04.title: A Repair With Two Costs
story.ch04.s04.objective: Prepare to isolate the Ashen Guardian and restore the heat release.
story.ch04.s04.forecast: Restoring the heat release will cool Ashen Peak and stop the immediate buildup. It will also reconnect the governor to both anchors. Stored pressure may surge through its damaged control shell.
story.ch04.s04.limit: Leaving this gate shut does not remove the risk. The Ashen reservoir is already above its safe heat limit. Isolate the automatic guard, release heat through the marked lanes, then replace the governor before the next full surge.
story.ch04.s04.apprentice: Cooling the peak is necessary. Calling it the end of the repair would leave Shen inside the same machine.
story.ch04.s04.brief: 1. Disable the Ashen guard. 2. Restore controlled heat release. 3. Return to the sanctuary as the storm gathers. 4. Read Yun’s sealed account and speak to the living guardian. 5. Replace the governor and end his service.
story.ch04.s04.response: I will open the release and return. The handover is part of the repair now.
story.ch04.s04.journal: The archive does not offer a safe way to do nothing: Ashen Peak is overheating. Cooling it may trigger the failing governor. The next objective is controlled release followed by a replacement, with Shen’s release required in every outcome.
story.ch04.s04.checkpoint: Ashen antechamber checkpoint saved. You may return to the sanctuary to change your loadout before the guard encounter.
story.ch04.s04.archive_access: Archive: Thirty-Day Compact / Renewal Ledger / Handover Register / Release Forecast. Reopen any entry from the journal.
story.ch04.s03.pulse_status: Isolated test circuit: mountain gauge stable; governor gauge rising. No change to the live array.
story.ch04.s03.pulse_observation: The first dial hardly moved. All that pressure went to the second. They could call the mountain safe without looking at what held it.
